newsitem.title: USA: News Corp to make announcement on ASkyB.
newsitem.headline: News Corp to make announcement on ASkyB.

text.p: A spokesman for News Corp said Monday it plans to hold a news conference to discuss its U.S. satellite television venture ASkyB, a company spokesman said.
The news conference is to be held 1600 PST/1900 EST a spokesman said.
Further details were not immediately available.

However, sources close to the company said earlier in the day that News Corp's daylong presentation to analysts and portfolio managers in Los Angeles was likely to end with an announcement of a new partner for ASkyB.
In afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange, the American Depository Receipts for News Corp were up 5/8 to 21-1/4.
